gold.title: Request payload typed `any` where the sibling handlers type theirs with a named interface
gold.description: users.ts and orders.ts each declare a payload interface (UserPayload, OrderPayload) and read req.body through it. refunds.ts types the same kind of value `any`, so orderId and amountCents are unchecked. Declare RefundPayload { orderId: string; amountCents: number } and use it.

candidate.title: `payload` typed `any` where sibling handlers declare a payload interface
candidate.description: Sibling handlers in `orders.ts` and `users.ts` declare proper payload interfaces and narrow with `as` casts. `refunds.ts` uses untyped `any`. Fix: declare `interface RefundPayload { orderId: string; amountCents: number }` and narrow with `req.body as RefundPayload`.
